[EN] You have come quite far. Look over there. Those argons want to kill us so that they can turn this world into their own. We cannot allow that to happen. We must kill them all.
[ES] Has llegado bastante lejos. Mira hacia allá. Esos argons quieren matarnos para poder convertir este mundo en el suyo. No podemos permitir que eso suceda. Debemos matarlos a todos.
